title: Hatchery
description: This datapack adds crafting recipes to all Spawn Eggs.
body:
## Introducing Hatchery!
The data pack adds crafting recipes to all Spawn Eggs and the Monster Spawner. It can be crafted with this recipe:
![A Monster Spawner being crafted using 3 Iron, 2 Netherite, 1 Dragon's Breath and 3 Obsidian.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f28183581e89255be57597bc255134914ca27eeb.png)
All the Spawn Eggs can be crafted using a Monster Spawner and a corresponding item. For example an Zombie Spawn Egg can be crafted using Rotten Flesh.
## Why Hatchery?
The data pack was made because sometimes you wanna spawn a mob asap but can't find it, that's why you can now craft and store them for later use!
## Support or Issues?
This is my second data pack, so sorry if there are bugs 😅. If you have any problems, feature suggestions or other you can join my helpful [Discord](https://discord.gg/XGxBGrJjkA).
### Thanks
Big thanks to [Legitimoose/Legitermoose](https://www.youtube.com/c/Legitimoose) and [100percentme](https://www.youtube.com/@100percentmeep) for helpful tutorials.
